question.text: Section 12AA of PMLA mandates enhanced due diligence for specified transactions using:

answer.text: Aadhaar authentication (with alternatives for persons not entitled to Aadhaar)

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 12AA uses Aadhaar authentication under Aadhaar Act 2016 with alternatives where applicable. The Trap: Random or single-mode checks are inadequate. Cross-Exam Context: Same process in XXIV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain audit log of authentication mode used per client.
